records.subject: Energy and Utilities
records.title: Water Prices, Annual
records.dataSource: MINISTRY OF SUSTAINABILITY AND THE ENVIRONMENT, PUB, SINGAPORE S NATIONAL WATER AGENCY
records.footnote: Data on water prices are as at end of December of each year.  Water is charged by per cubic metre, which is equivalent to 1,000 litres. Excludes Goods and Services Tax.  Water prices remain unchanged unless revised.  Year 2025 data reflect the latest water prices that took effect from 1 April 2025.

row.rowText: Potable Water Price For Domestic Users, 0-40 Cubic Metres
row.footnote: Potable water for domestic use are supplied to premises used exclusively for residential purposes.  This includes residential premises approved for use as home offices under the Home Office Scheme.  Properties where any part of the premises is used for or in connection with any trade, business, or profession, or as a hotel, serviced apartment, boarding house, hostel, school, place of worship, or mess do not qualify as domestic use.
From 1 July 1997, Water Conservation Tax was imposed on Potable Water.
From 1 July 2017, the Sanitary Appliance Fee (Dollar Per Fitting) was combined with the Waterborne Fee into a single, volume-based fee.  The Waterborne Fee was renamed to Waterborne Tax in 2023.
For the calculation of total price, the Sanitary Appliance Fee is converted to its volumetric equivalent.

row.rowText: Potable Water Price For Non-Domestic Users
row.footnote: Potable water for non-domestic use are supplied to premises other than those used exclusively for residential purposes, including those used for commercial, institutional, industrial, or mixed purposes.  Non-domestic tariffs apply to hotels, restaurants, construction sites, and any premises not eligible for domestic tariffs or shipping tariffs.
From 1 July 1997, Water Conservation Tax was imposed on Potable Water.
From 1 July 2017, the Sanitary Appliance Fee (Dollar Per Fitting) was combined with the Waterborne Fee into a single, volume-based fee.  The Waterborne Fee was renamed to Waterborne Tax in 2023.
For the calculation of total price, the Sanitary Appliance Fee is converted to its volumetric equivalent.
